genius.notes: The BMA Class M license is a foreign digital-asset business license, not GENIUS approval or a registered foreign-issuer exception. VNX Global Ltd. is the current Bermuda issuer; VNX Commodities AG records describe the historical structure. Current institutional documentation restricts direct minting/redemption to verified institutional customers and states a CHF 100,000 minimum transaction threshold for VCHF. Fiat redemption through direct cancellation or liquidity-pool buyback averages about one business day, subject to governing terms, eligibility, AML/ATF checks and liquidity conditions. Terms retain reserve-related delay and in-kind redemption. The issuer's audits hub publicly links Apex Fund Services Ltd.'s July and August 2026 monthly reserve attestations, with ISAE 3000 reasonable assurance; no September report was linked when retrieved October 17, 2026. The August VCHF liability table covers Stellar, Ethereum, Solana, ICP, Celo and Base, but omits the tracked Tezos, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Polygon, XRPL and Fraxtal deployments, so it does not reconcile all tracked supply. Authorization and negative-evidence findings retain their October 7, 2026 review; this correction updates issuer disclosures, not U.S. authorization. GENIUS remains pre-effective; Treasury expects January 18, 2027, subject to the enacted earlier-final-rule trigger. The September 30 SCRC procedural rule is not issuer qualification or an earlier commencement rule; the July 18, 2028 DASP deadline is separate.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public PPSI approval, qualified-state approval, official GENIUS application, registered foreign-issuer exception or GENIUS enforcement action naming VNX Global Ltd/VCHF was located in these bounded checks on October 7, 2026. BMA and current contractual disclosures establish the foreign issuer, not U.S. qualification. The OCC table covers digital-asset bank applications and is not an exhaustive GENIUS issuer register. A foreign-exception finding cannot be inferred from a Bermuda license. Treasury expects January 18, 2027 effectiveness, subject to the statute's earlier-final-rule trigger; the SCRC procedural IFR does not itself commence the issuer regime.
